# Unified traveller entry — 5.0.0

All seven authored protagonists are selectable on the first visit. New games use the 14 authored origin maps, not the separate borrowed-kit field trials. The chosen protagonist carries earned resources, discipline and identity into the festival and remains first in the party. Existing historical saves without the new journey marker keep their prior reset semantics.

Each protagonist has one browser-local resumable slot. Rerolls archive the prior active telling; starting a new origin preserves prior historical records. Six item disciplines and three starting supply threads provide 18 initial weaves. Civic repair, conflict and destiny decisions remain player choices.

The quick arrow resumes a traveller. A plus appears for a ready traveller who can join the active present-day crew. Joining preserves the leader and quest state and limits the active crew to three; the displaced companion remains recruited. It brings the traveller's identity and discipline, not another save's money or levels. This is local companion drop-in, not network multiplayer.

Regional commissions use the same World state, frontier ledger, inventory and save as the main campaign. An active commission appears on its saved traveller's entry details. The historical origin practice mode remains in source for compatibility with old saves but is no longer offered by the entry or approach menu.

Character presentation uses a WebGL curved front/back relief mesh with the canonical character artwork, manual orbit, automatic turntable, silhouette cleanup and a 2D fallback. No rigged volumetric character assets are present. Reduced motion stops automatic rotation. Controls use larger touch targets while the existing measured battle dock continues reserving the world viewport.
